Developers' notes: We apologise for the lack of updates and communication these past few months. We've been hard at work with the process of porting Roguematch to consoles to line up with the full release of the game on the consoles as well as Steam. However, that required us to undertake an overhaul of the game's internal game engine so we were not able to push out updates as frequently as we would have liked to because we still needed to ensure the full game would be in a playable state after the overhaul was completed. We have quite a number of features that have been compiled from the past few months of work put into this patch and we hope to be able to move back to more frequent game and communication updates regarding the game soon.
